rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (12 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Girl_Happy_(album), https://www.discogs.com/release/2495929-Elvis-Presley-Girl-Happy. Original LP RCA Victor LPM/LSP 3338 (Mar 1965), 12 tracks. 'You'll Be Gone' is a bonus track not from the film — taken from the March 1962 Pot Luck sessions, co-written by Elvis Presley, Charlie Hodge and Red West.
